This PR remains closed as an unmerged historical source; its branch and original run are preserved.

The 100k rep0 job `114000097090` has no uploaded measurement ZIP. In the terminal official response its execution step remains `in_progress` and its final upload step is `pending`. The original full-log endpoint returned 404 `BlobNotFound`; the supported connector cannot retrieve the one check annotation's contents. **The native child exit, last phase and cause remain unknown.** There is no evidence here to label this OOM, disk exhaustion, cancellation or the five-hour native deadline.

The original aggregate job `114077867196` actually exited 1 and its untouched failed matrix lists precisely **146 missing slots**: five scales × repetitions 1–29, plus 100k rep0. The matrix JSON has no `sample_count` field. The original accepted counts remain **4/150 shards and 41/1500 observations**; no later run will be spliced into this source cohort.

[Complete available terminal originals](https://github.com/jyqj/codecortex/tree/2b1d5f1e9d24475c2d6aa6efab72a6c1d9bcb1e1/artifacts/checkpoints/p8-round31-GW4-terminal-originals-bfcc-20261010) retain the original failed-matrix ZIP, member, full aggregate log, official API responses and failed-access records. A [nonauthor boundary review](https://github.com/jyqj/codecortex/tree/2b1d5f1e9d24475c2d6aa6efab72a6c1d9bcb1e1/artifacts/checkpoints/p8-round31-GW4-terminal-boundary-bfcc-20261010) independently checked the complete missing-slot set and evidence limits.

That candidate is only being prepared; it has not been run and grants no sample or TODO completion credit. Current main still has **164/192 done, 28 remaining**.
